MOCK VERSION 1 · EFFECTIVE OCTOBER 17, 2026

Your space.
Your privacy.

This notice explains how this Intend website and interactive preview work today. It does not describe a future product with accounts, health connections, or saved history.

Your reflections are not sent to a server. What you type in the app stays in the memory of that open page. Refreshing, closing, or leaving the app clears it.

1. Who is behind this preview

Intend is a journaling and self-reflection concept. This web preview is developed by Orso Solutions LLC, using the OTORO development and security brand. For questions about this preview, contact Orso Solutions through otoro.si. Please do not include journal entries or sensitive health details in your inquiry.

2. Information you enter

You may try a first name or nickname, intentions, mood selections, reflections, habit names and completions, water counts, and preference settings. The app uses those inputs only to display the interactive experience in your current page. There is no account registration, journal database, cloud sync, or permanent history in mock version 1.

Our preview code does not transmit these inputs to Orso Solutions, OTORO, an AI provider, an advertiser, or an analytics service. Please use sample information rather than confidential or sensitive information.

3. Storage and clearing your entries

The app does not use local storage, session storage, IndexedDB, application cookies, or a service worker to retain your entries. The “Clear this preview” control in My space resets the page's in-memory entries and preferences. Refreshing or leaving the app starts a fresh preview, including when returning through the browser's back button.

Normal browser features, extensions, device backups, screenshots, keyboard services, and autofill are outside our control. Anyone who can see your screen can see what you enter. The website's static files may be cached by your browser; those files do not contain your personal reflections.

4. Website delivery and technical information

Your browser must contact the hosting provider to load the website. Hosting, network, and security infrastructure may process routine request information, such as IP address, browser information, requested URLs, and timestamps, to deliver and protect the site. We do not place your reflections in URLs or requests.

A privately hosted preview may also be subject to the hosting platform's access controls, authentication cookies, and privacy terms. Those controls are separate from Intend's app, which has no sign-up or login. This notice does not claim that the hosting provider keeps no operational logs.

5. Tracking, selling, and sharing

This preview includes no advertising pixels, third-party analytics, session replay, or remote font requests. We do not sell or share journal entries; our preview code does not receive them. We do not use your entries to train an AI model. External links, including OTORO links, take you to services with their own practices and privacy notices.

6. Health data, photos, and reminders

This preview requests no access to health records, step counts, sleep, workouts, camera, photo library, contacts, microphone, or location. Journal scanning and health integrations are planned features only. Reminder settings are a demonstration and do not schedule or send notifications.

Pattern charts and recipes are clearly labeled fictional examples. They are not generated from your input and are not personalized health recommendations.

7. Your choices and questions

You can explore without supplying a real name or personal information. You can stop using the preview at any time and clear the current page through My space. Because journal entries are not received or stored by us, we cannot retrieve, export, or recover them after the page resets.

If you contact us separately, we may receive the information you choose to send so we can respond. Use the contact options at otoro.si for privacy questions or requests about information you have provided directly to Orso Solutions. Do not post private information in public repository issues.

8. Future versions

We will update this notice before introducing new data practices such as accounts, cloud storage, health integrations, journal scanning, or analytics. Any required permissions and consent will be requested for those features. The effective date above identifies the version of this notice.
